subject: Incident: Finacorp throughput & error spike — evidence staging and retention plan
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finacorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Andre Liu <andre.liu@finacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: High latency & error spike this morning — need logs and retention details

Hi Logan / Monica,

We saw a sharp spike in 5xx errors and sustained latency increases across our production routes this morning between 06:40–07:15 PDT. Our ops and incident response teams raised this to our execs — they want a short runbook of what artifacts Redwood can provide for a forensic review and what the retention/chain-of-custody will look like if we escalate to a formal audit.

Specifically we need: 1) full request/response traces for the affected timeframe; 2) any sampling or aggregated token-level telemetry; 3) an authoritative statement of how long raw runtime logs are retained and how we can get an export; 4) any KV/cache eviction logs if relevant.

Please treat this as high priority — our legal and security teams may request evidence custody. How fast can you stage this data and what approvals do you need from us?

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gomez
Head of Platform Operations, Finacorp

Attachments: (none)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike this morning — need logs and retention details

Maria — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. I’m on this now and looping in infra, incident response, and legal. Proposed immediate plan:

- We will stage a time-bounded evidence package containing request/response logs, runtime traces, and the audit manifest for 06:30–07:30 PDT.
- Engineering will confirm whether any KV cache eviction events overlap the window.
- Legal will outline custody and transfer steps (DocuSign + evidence checklist).
- Target: staged export available to your S3 endpoint or secured transfer within 24 hours, with a signed transfer agreement beforehand.

Action items for Redwood internal team (assigning):
- Priyom: collect runtime telemetry + manifest, create zip, and upload to secure drive.
- Tessa: prepare a concise operations summary for Finacorp execs (1 pager).
- Vanessa: prepare evidence transfer checklist and confirm what legal approvals we need from Finacorp.

Maria — can you confirm the preferred transfer method (S3 upload vs secure scp) and whether you can sign an evidence transfer authorization today?

I’ll keep you posted every 2 hours until we hand off.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 1) preliminary-incident-timeline.txt (see below)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike this morning — need logs and retention details

Quick update from infra: we can produce the following artifacts for 06:30–07:30 PDT (window covers observed spikes):

- request_response_log_20270914_0630-0730.jsonl (full request/response payloads, redacted per PII rules) — stored in internal S3: s3://redwood-exports/finacorp/20270914/runtime-telemetry-0630-0730.zip
- runtime_traces_20270914_0630-0730.tar.gz (per-container OpenTelemetry spans)
- kv_eviction_log_20270914.csv (shows cache evictions by shard/timestamp)
- token_histograms_20270914.csv (aggregate token distribution and tokenization errors)
- instance-metrics-0630-0730.csv (CPU/GPU/queue-latency samples per host)
- audit-manifest-20270914.csv (hashes + export manifest)

Notes/constraints:
- Default retention: request-level logs are kept 90 days; sampling-level metrics are kept 365 days. We can produce a 7/30/90-day export on request.
- Some request payloads include customer PII — exports will be redacted unless Finacorp signs a data transfer authorization.
- Estimated export time: 3–6 hours to prepare and validate checksums; add 1 hour for upload to an external S3 endpoint if provided.

I’ll start packaging now and will upload to s3://redwood-exports/finacorp/20270914/ if we don’t receive external endpoint details in 2 hours.

— Priyom
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-20270914.zip (placeholder)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike this morning — evidence transfer and chain-of-custody

Team — legal quick notes:

- We need a signed Evidence Transfer Authorization (ETA) from Finacorp prior to transferring any raw request-level payloads that may contain customer PII. I’ve drafted a one-page ETA; I can send a DocuSign link to Maria once she confirms.
- Chain-of-custody: exports will include an audit-manifest.csv with SHA256 checksums, export timestamps, and the operator ID. We will preserve original object IDs in case of later subpoena.
- Recommended retention posture for the export: create an immutable export (write-once) and store under the Finacorp access-controlled bucket for 90 days by default unless they request longer. If Finacorp requests legal hold beyond 90 days, we will escalate to an enterprise contract addendum.
- Forensics requirement: we should snapshot the runtime environment metadata (kernel version, docker image digests, model repo commit hash) and include that in the manifest.

I will circulate the ETA and the evidence checklist once Priyom confirms the file list.

— Vanessa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-evidence-checklist-template.pdf (template)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finacorp.com>, Andre Liu <andre.liu@finacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike this morning — evidence staging and retention plan

Hi Maria / Andre — consolidated update and request: we have packaged the artifacts Priyom listed and prepared an audit manifest. Before we transfer any files that may contain PII, Vanessa needs Finacorp to sign the one-page Evidence Transfer Authorization (DocuSign link below). Once signed we will:

1) Upload runtime-telemetry-20270914.zip and evidence-manifest-20270914.csv to your preferred S3 bucket (or we can stage to our secure drive if you prefer).
2) Set export as immutable for 90 days and provide checksums for verification.
3) Provide a 1-page operations summary and a technical appendix for your security team.

DocuSign link (ETA): https://docusign.com/./sign/ABC123-finacorp-evidence
Estimated handoff ETA after signature: 4 hours.

Please confirm transfer method and sign the ETA at your earliest convenience. If you prefer, we can schedule a quick call to walk through the manifest and chain-of-custody.

Thanks — we're treating this as priority and will keep you updated.

— Logan

Attachments: evidence-manifest-20270914.csv, operations-summary-brief.pdf

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finacorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Andre Liu <andre.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike this morning — evidence staging and retention plan

Logan — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity. Andre and I reviewed the proposed artifacts and we can sign the ETA today. We prefer S3 upload to our secure bucket (I’ll send credentials via the secure channel).

Request from our side: please make sure the audit-manifest includes the image digests and model commit hash mentioned by Vanessa. Also include an AVC (approved verification contact) so our security ops can confirm checksums on arrival.

We’ll sign the DocuSign link and share the endpoint details by EOD. Schedule an intake call for 3pm PDT today so we can review with our security team.

— Maria

Attachments: signed-authorization-expected.pdf (placeholder)
